manual_findings: Nine structs, one enum and one alias carry numeric identities/owned family and coordinate declarations. IDs do not own the font database or pin resources, and FaceIndex is a collection-source index distinct from FontFaceId.

single_family and regular construct owned values and fixed400/Normal/100 defaults; regular also uses index0 and empty axes. Actual consumers perform matching, registration, source validity and coverage checks later.

Only clamped explicitly constrains FontWeight100..=900 and FontStretch50..=200. Direct tuple construction and derived Deserialize do not call these functions. Stretch is selection preference, not layout scale; TextStyle helper has a separate1..=1000 policy.

VariationCoords owns an unchecked Vec of axis declarations. Actual database.instance validates face then effective_variations and registry.resolve_or_insert canonicalization; normalization/instance identity is a consumer boundary, not a Serde hook or angle-unit contract.

All10derive,2serde-default and1default-variant attributes and the ownedvec macro input are byte-preserved. Missing variations/faces select empty defaults; FontStyle Default is Normal. Floating variants do not acquire Eq/finite guarantees.
Family descriptor original two-line type documentation is adequate; its14LF stay byte-identical. This is a reviewed unchanged source, not an unreviewed omission.

One preexisting TODO remains exactly once. Root confirms angle bits in cache key versus payload-ignoring score; this establishes the recorded question, not a proven functional defect or the intended angle unit. Reuse existing LEGACY key and preserve initial pin/line.

Owned tests0. One external synthetic stored-face test compares equal/different axis instance IDs through2assertions; static only and does not prove real-font rendering, global ID stability, angle behavior or coverage.
